plugins.name: klipper-hooks
plugins.title: Print Lifecycle Hooks
plugins.description: Lets any macro named _PRINT_START_*, _PRINT_END_*, or _CANCEL_PRINT_* run automatically as part of PRINT_START / PRINT_END / CANCEL_PRINT, without editing those core macros. Drop a [gcode_macro _PRINT_START_my_thing] in your config and it just runs. Hooks are run in sorted name order, so prefix them with a number (e.g. _PRINT_START_10_purge, _PRINT_START_20_level) to control sequencing. DANGER: if two hooks must run in a specific order and you do not number them, the order is only as stable as their names; an unordered hook that depends on another can misfire. Experimental and not yet verified on a physical printer; it overrides PRINT_START/PRINT_END/CANCEL_PRINT, so it can conflict with other plugins that override the same macros.
plugins.tagline: Auto-run _PRINT_START_* / _PRINT_END_* hooks. Number them to order them.

plugins.name: moonraker-notify
plugins.title: Print Notifications
plugins.description: Sends a push notification when a print finishes, fails, or errors, using Moonraker's [notifier] and the Apprise library. Apprise speaks to about a hundred services from one address: Telegram, Discord, Slack, ntfy, Pushover, email, Matrix, Home Assistant, and more. Paste the Apprise URL for your service (e.g. ntfy://ntfy.sh/your-topic or tgram://bottoken/chatid) and pick which events to be told about. The Apprise library is baked into the package and linked into Moonraker's interpreter at install; no pip ever runs on the printer.
plugins.tagline: Get a ping on your phone or chat when a print finishes or fails.

config.label: Notifier name
config.hint: A label for this destination; you can install more than one.

config.label: Apprise URL
config.hint: Your service's Apprise URL. See github.com/caronc/apprise for the format per service.

config.label: Notify on
config.hint: Which print events trigger a notification.

plugins.name: prometheus-exporter
plugins.title: Prometheus Exporter
plugins.description: Runs scross01/prometheus-klipper-exporter as a managed service, exposing Klipper/Moonraker metrics in Prometheus format at :9101/metrics so you can scrape them into Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, etc. The exporter is a small Go binary cross-compiled for the printer in CI and baked into the package; nothing is built on the printer. Observability for people who run a metrics stack; most users will not need it. Experimental, not yet verified on a physical printer.
plugins.tagline: Klipper/Moonraker metrics in Prometheus format for Grafana & co.

plugins.name: wled
plugins.title: WLED Status Lights
plugins.description: Connects a network-attached WLED LED strip to Moonraker's built-in [wled] support, so your printer can drive status lighting (and you can control it from Fluidd/Mainsail and from macros). Point it at your WLED device's address and set how many LEDs it has. WLED hardware is separate; this only configures Moonraker to talk to it.
plugins.tagline: Drive a WLED LED strip from your printer.

config.label: Strip name
config.hint: Name used in macros and the UI, e.g. WLED_ON STRIP=status.

config.label: WLED address
config.hint: Hostname or IP of your WLED device.

config.label: LED count
config.hint: Number of LEDs on the strip.
